newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's CNMV suspends Bodegas Bilbainas.
newsitem.headline: Spain's CNMV suspends Bodegas Bilbainas.

text.p: Spain's national stock market commission CNMV said on Tuesday it had suspended trading in wine producer Bodegas Bilbainas SA after Duode SA, a unit of cava makers Codorniu, said it was making a takeover bid for it.

"(The CNMV) has suspended as a precautionary measure trade on the Bilbao bourse in Bodegas Bilbainas due to circumstances that could disrupt the normal progress of operations in the cited share," the CNMV said in a statement.

Duode SA said in a statement to the CNMV that it was bidding for 100 percent of the shares of Bodegas Bilbainas at a per share price of 6,000 pesetas on the condition that it acquired at least 51 percent of the shares.
Bodegas Bilbainas closed last Friday at 4,450 pesetas on the Bilbao bourse.
